project.name: PatientTriage.ai
project.summary: Explainable, safety-biased clinical decision-support triage system with dynamic deterioration tracking, active VOI questioning, and regulatory audit trail.

app.label: Streamlit Clinical HUD
app.summary: Interactive 3-workstation clinical dashboard: Intake/Scorer, Waiting Room Radar, and Audit/Override Log.

triage.models.label: Clinical Data Contracts
triage.models.summary: Pydantic v2 schemas: PatientRecord, Vitals, AgeCategory, ESILevel, TriageResult.

triage.rules.label: Physiological Red-Lines
triage.rules.summary: Age-stratified deterministic vital thresholds & red-lines (PEWS, NEWS2, qSOFA).

triage.engine.label: Base & Algorithmic Triage Engine
triage.engine.summary: Abstract BaseTriageEngine contract and deterministic AlgorithmicTriageEngine core (<50ms SLA).

triage.voi.label: Active Value-of-Information (VOI) Engine
triage.voi.summary: Entropy-reducing clinical follow-up question bank triggered when confidence < 70%.

triage.queue.label: Dynamic Queue & Deterioration Radar
triage.queue.summary: Safe wait-time degradation, re-triage breach alerts, and 3x surge mode routing.

triage.audit.label: Immutable Audit Trail
triage.audit.summary: Append-only audit ledger recording AI suggestions, VOI Q&A, and clinician overrides with justifications.

triage.cohort.label: 20-Patient Benchmark Cohort
triage.cohort.summary: Pre-configured synthetic test patients across pediatric, adult, and geriatric clinical presentations.

dec.001.label: DEC-001: Pydantic v2 Schema Contracts
dec.001.summary: Enforces strict boundary validation and zero-copy JSON serialization.

dec.002.label: DEC-002: Declarative Rule Registry
dec.002.summary: Isolates physiological red-line thresholds from engine orchestration mechanics.

dec.003.label: DEC-003: Pluggable Repository Pattern
dec.003.summary: Supports in-memory dev execution and production Redis/SQL queue/audit backends.

metric.confidence.label: Confidence Formula (0.0–1.0)
metric.confidence.summary: 1.0 - P(data) - P(vitals) - P(ambiguity) - P(age_risk). Triggers VOI when < 0.70.

facts.fact: Evaluation latency SLA is strictly under 50ms (deterministic core runs in ~0.8ms).
Asymmetric loss: Under-triage (ESI 1/2 assigned to 3/4) is 10x worse than over-triage.
Safe waiting thresholds: ESI 1 = 0m, ESI 2 = 10m, ESI 3 = 30m, ESI 4 = 60m, ESI 5 = 120m.
Active VOI questions trigger whenever epistemic confidence falls below 70%.
Every clinician override requires a mandatory justification and writes an immutable audit record.
